```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```



```{r load X data}
setwd("/path/to/project/Other data/Simulated Genotypes/")
file_name = "data_sub2_raw.raw"

df <- read.table(file_name, header = TRUE)
```


```{r transform X data}
df <- df[7:ncol(df)]
colnames(df) <- paste0("v", seq_len(ncol(df)))
save(df, file = 'X.Rdata')
```
